title: iberis corifolia
intro: Iberis corifolia, commonly known as Candytuft, is a flowering plant native to Europe and Western Asia. It is valued for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and restlessness due to its calming effects. The health benefits of Iberis corifolia include its ability to reduce stress and promote relaxation, which can be attributed to its therapeutic actions such as sedation and anxiolysis. The bioactive constituents of Iberis corifolia include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
